fundamentals.long_business_summary: IQM Quantum Computers Oyj builds and delivers quantum computers. The company offers full-stack quantum computing systems, including the IQM Spark, IQM Radiance, and IQM Halocene models, as well as the IQM Resonance cloud platform. It serves research institutions, universities, high-performance computing centers, and enterprises. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Espoo, Finland.
